blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. This survey reviews its development, focusing on the Foundation Model Era. We define OCR through faithful transcription: within a specified visual scope, OCR should completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image, and every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image. We trace the development from specialist OCR models toward unified models, examining joint text detection and recognition, structured sequence generation, and the use of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We organize contemporary OCR systems into five coexisting families: modular toolkits and task-specific models, specialized document VLMs, hybrid workflows, general-purpose VLMs, and commercial products and managed services. We compare their architectures, data, and training, examining hallucination and omission, insufficient spatial grounding, and inference cost in generative OCR. We review evaluation from character and scene text recognition to parsing individual structural elements and full-page transcription, highlighting gaps in consistent output definitions, attribution of performance to individual components, and coverage of real capture conditions and visible content and structure. Finally, we summarize the challenges facing OCR and discuss directions for future research. We continuously track related work at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era.
blocks.zh: 光学字符识别(OCR)是人工智能最古老和部署最广泛的应用之一. 这项调查审查了其发展情况,重点是基础模型时代。 我们通过忠实的转录来定义OCR:在指定的视觉范围内,OCR应该完全重建文本,注音,以及源图像中可观测到的文档结构,输出中的每一个文字,注音,或结构元素都必须从该图像中的视觉证据中可以核实. 我们追踪从专业OCR模型向统一模型的发展,审查联合文本检测和识别,结构化序列生成,以及使用预先训练的视觉语言模型。 我们把当代的OCR系统组织成五个共存的家庭:模块化工具包和任务特定模型,专门的文件VLM,混合工作流程,通用VLM,以及商业产品和管理的服务. 我们比较他们的结构、数据和培训, 检查幻觉和遗漏, 空间定位不足, 以及遗传性OCR的推论成本。 我们审查从特征和场景文本识别到解析单个结构要素和整页抄录的评价,强调在一致的产出定义、业绩归属于单个组成部分以及涵盖真实捕捉条件和可见内容和结构方面的差距。 最后,我们总结OCR面临的挑战,并讨论未来研究的方向。 我们不断在https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era追踪相关工作。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. Efforts to read printed text by machine date back to the 1910s [ 1 ] , and by the 1950s dedicated OCR devices matched optically sensed character patterns against stored templates to produce machine-readable codes [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 光学字符识别(OCR)是人工智能最古老,部署最广泛的应用之一. 通过机器读取印刷文本的努力可以追溯到1910年代[1],到1950年代,专用的OCR设备将光学感应字符模式与存储模板相匹配,以产生机器可读代码[2].

blocks.en: Over the following decades, OCR moved well beyond its original reliance on dedicated hardware. The targets of recognition expanded along several axes: from printed to handwritten text [ 3 ] , from scanned pages to text captured in natural scenes as cameras became ubiquitous [ 4 ] , and from plain passages to documents with rich structures such as tables, formulas, and layouts with multiple columns [ 5 , 6 ] . Generative models, increasingly built on pretrained vision–language models (VLMs), produce JSON, Markdown, HTML, or L a T e X directly from document images [ 7 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 在接下来的几十年里,OCR已经远远超出了最初对专用硬件的依赖. 识别目标沿着几个轴线扩展:从印刷文字到手写文字[3],从扫描页到照相机变得无处不在时在自然场景中捕获的文字[4],从简单的段落到表格、公式和多列布局等结构丰富的文件[5,6]. generative models,日益建立在预先训练的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)上,直接从文档图像产生JSON,Markdown,HTML,或L a T e X[7,8].

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Scope of this survey. Within a specified visual scope, OCR aims to completely recover visible text, notation, and document structure, with every output element verifiable against the source image. Main coverage spans printed, handwritten, and scene text; formulas as notation; and tables, layout, and reading order as structure. Key information extraction, question answering, translation, and retrieval are downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 图1:本调查的范围。 在指定的视觉范围内,OCR旨在完全恢复可见的文本,注音,文档结构,每个输出元素都与源图像相对可核查. 主要覆盖范围包括印刷、手写和场景文本;公式作为标记;以及表格、布局和阅读顺序作为结构。 关键信息提取,问答,翻译,检索都是下游任务.

blocks.en: What counts as OCR? The literature uses OCR with different boundaries: technology for scanned documents [ 4 ] , camera-based OCR [ 9 ] , artificial optical signals [ 8 ] , text and visual structure recovery in holistic OCR [ 10 ] , and multimodal evaluations that include information extraction and document question answering [ 11 ] . In this survey, we define OCR through faithful transcription . Within a specified visual scope, OCR aims to completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image. Every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image (Fig. 1 ). Normalization must follow a declared output convention. Our main coverage includes printed, handwritten, and scene text, mathematical formulas, tables, layout, and reading order. Chart data, flowchart connections, musical notation, and chemical structures can also be recovered from visual evidence; we discuss these as related extensions with selective coverage.
blocks.zh: 何谓OCR? 文献使用具有不同边界的OCR:扫描文件的技术[4],基于相机的OCR[9],人工光学信号[8],整体OCR[10]中的文本和视觉结构恢复,以及包括信息提取和文档问题回答的多式联运评价[11]. 在此次调查中,我们通过忠实的文字记录来定义OCR。 在指定的视觉范围内,OCR旨在完全重建在源图像中可观测到的文本,标记和文档结构. 输出中的每个文字,注音,或结构元素都必须从该图像中的视觉证据中可核查(图1). 正常化必须遵循宣布的产出公约。 我们的主要报道包括印刷、手写和场景文本、数学公式、表格、布局和阅读顺序。 图表数据,流程图连接,音乐符号,和化学结构也可以从视觉证据中恢复;我们讨论这些作为相关的扩展,有选择性的覆盖.

blocks.en: Recovering a table’s cells, rows, and merged cells, or the values a chart encodes through marks and axes, reconstructs the source document; computing a statistic from those values or explaining a trend goes beyond it. Document understanding assigns semantic fields [ 12 ] , answers questions [ 13 ] , or draws conclusions about a document [ 14 , 15 ] . These downstream tasks have influenced OCR architectures, training, and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 恢复表格的单元格、行和合并的单元格,或通过标记和轴编码的图表值,重建源文档;从这些值中计算一个统计数据或解释一个趋势超出了它的范围。 文件理解指定语义字段[12],回答问题[13],或对文件[14,15]作出结论. 这些下游任务影响了OCR的架构,培训和评价.

blocks.en: From specialist models to unified models: Fig. 2 traces three overlapping eras: the Classical OCR, Deep Learning, and Foundation Model eras. Classical methods relied on templates, handcrafted features, and statistical models. Deep learning brought learned features and sequence prediction, while pipelines continued to assemble outputs from specialist components [ 16 ] . Joint modeling also developed: Mask TextSpotter [ 17 ] integrated detection and recognition in one network, SPTS [ 18 ] represented locations and text in one output sequence, and OmniParser [ 19 ] supported text spotting, table recognition, and key information extraction within a common framework.
blocks.zh: 从专业模型到统一模型: 图2 追溯三个重叠的时代:古典OCR,Deep Learning,以及基础模型时代. 古典方法依赖模板、手工制作的特征和统计模型。 深入学习带来了学到的特征和顺序预测,而管道则继续汇集专家部分的产出[16]。 还开发了联合模型: Mask TextSpotter [17] 在一个网络中进行综合检测和识别,SBS [18]在一个输出序列中代表位置和文本,OmniParser [19]支持在一个共同框架内进行文本检测、表识别和关键信息提取。

blocks.en: The Foundation Model Era expanded task sharing through large-scale pretraining and structured generation. Donut [ 7 ] generated structured results for document tasks directly from images, and Nougat [ 20 ] adapted this approach to full-page scientific transcription. GOT-OCR [ 8 ] and HunyuanOCR [ 21 ] used pretrained large language models (LLMs) to support multiple tasks and content types in one model. The development from specialist to unified models thus spans these eras, with increasing sharing of networks, representations, and decoders.
blocks.zh: 基金会模式 大纪元通过大规模预训和结构化生成扩大了任务分担. Donut[7]直接从图像中为文件任务产生了结构化的结果,Nougat[20]将这种方法改编为全页科学抄录. Got-OCR [8]和HunyuanOCR [21] 使用预训大语言模型(LLMs)支持一个模型中的多个任务和内容类型. 因此,从专家模式发展到统一模式跨越了这些时代,网络、表述和解码器的共享越来越多。

blocks.en: In practice, unified models can generate complete pages or work with layout analysis to generate regions before document assembly. Specialist models, whole-page generation, and regional generation continue to coexist; Section III compares their architectures.
blocks.zh: 在实务中,统一模型可以生成完整的页面或与布局分析一起工作,在文件组装之前生成区域. 专家模型、整页生成和区域生成继续共存;第三节比较了它们的架构。

Years mark publications, public announcements, or system releases; horizontal spacing is schematic. Asterisks identify precursors: the optophone as a reading aid, and Donut and Pix2Struct in document understanding and image-to-sequence pretraining. Section II covers classical and deep learning methods; Section III examines unified models and generative parsing.

blocks.en: Why does OCR need a new survey? Mori et al. [ 2 ] reviewed the historical development of OCR. Ye and Doermann [ 4 ] , Zhu et al. [ 25 ] , Long et al. [ 26 ] , and Chen et al. [ 9 ] surveyed scene text detection and recognition across different stages of its development. Liu et al. [ 27 ] provided a broader review of intelligent document analysis and recognition. Recent surveys examine OCR with large models [ 28 ] , document intelligence and parsing [ 106 , 107 , 108 ] , text-centric image understanding [ 109 ] , visual text processing and manipulation [ 110 , 29 ] , or general vision–language models that include OCR among many capabilities [ 30 ] . They adopt different boundaries for OCR.
blocks.zh: 为什么OCR需要新的调查? 莫里等译. [2]回顾了OCR的历史发展. 叶与杜尔曼[4],朱等. [25],龙等 [26],陈等. [9] 对其不同发展阶段的场景文本检测和识别情况进行了调查。 刘等. [27]提供了对智能文件分析和识别的更广泛的审查。 最近的调查用大模型[28],文件智能和剖析[106,107,108],文字中心图像理解[109],视觉文本处理和操纵[110,29],或一般视觉语言模型来检查OCR,这些模型在许多能力中包括OCR[30]. 他们为OCR采用了不同的界限.

blocks.en: In the Foundation Model Era, a single system can perform transcription, structural recovery, and downstream understanding, while specialist models, unified models, and hybrid workflows continue to coexist. This survey connects research on specialist OCR and unified models to explain how OCR has changed in the Foundation Model Era and which problems warrant further research. Fig. 3 outlines the survey’s structure.
blocks.zh: 在"基础模型时代"中,一个单一的系统可以进行转录,结构恢复,和下游理解,而专业模型,统一模型,和混合工作流程继续共存. 这项调查将关于专业OCR的研究和统一模型联系起来,以解释OCR在基础模型时代是如何改变的,哪些问题值得进一步研究. 图3概述了调查的结构。

blocks.en:
Contributions: (i) We systematically review the major stages and technical transitions of OCR, tracing its development from specialist models toward unified models with a focus on the Foundation Model Era.
(ii) We define OCR through faithful transcription and organize contemporary systems into five families, comparing their architectures, data, and training.
(iii) We trace OCR evaluation from text recognition to full-page parsing, analyze recognition and structural recovery using published results, and identify gaps in output definitions, score attribution, and coverage of multilingual content, long documents, and real capture conditions.
(iv) Focusing on faithful transcription, we discuss output reliability, the coexistence of specialist, unified, and hybrid approaches, and the expanding scope of content recovery.
blocks.zh:
贡献:(一) 我们系统地审查OCR的主要阶段和技术过渡,追踪从专家模式到以基础模型时代为重点的统一模式的发展。
(二)我们通过忠实的抄录来定义OCR,并将当代系统组织成五个家庭,比较它们的架构,数据,培训.
(三) 我们追踪OCR评价从文本识别到全页解析,利用公布的结果分析识别和结构恢复,并找出产出定义、分数归属和多语种内容覆盖面、长文件和真实获取条件方面的差距。
(四)注重忠实的抄录,讨论产出可靠性,专家共存,统一,混合的方法,内容回收范围不断扩大.

blocks.en: This survey aims to help newcomers understand OCR and provide experienced researchers with a reference for recent advances and open problems.
blocks.zh: 这项调查旨在帮助新来者了解OCR,并为有经验的研究人员提供最近的进展和公开问题的参考。

blocks.en: II Historical Evolution of OCR
blocks.zh: OCR的历史演变

blocks.en: This section traces how OCR recovered visible text and its location, and how these predictions became increasingly integrated for document reconstruction. Detailed surveys cover these eras [ 2 , 4 , 25 , 26 , 9 , 27 ] ; Figs. 2 and 4 summarize their evolution.
blocks.zh: 本节追踪OCR如何回收可见文本及其位置,以及这些预测如何日益融入文件重建. 详细调查涵盖了这些时代[2,4,25,26,9,27];图. 2和4总结了它们的演变.

blocks.en: II-A Classical OCR Era
blocks.zh: II-A 经典OCR时代

blocks.en: Early optical reading devices included the optophone (1914), which encoded printed patterns as tones for a listener to interpret, and Tauschek’s template-matching machine (1929). Commercial OCR later used standardized fonts and controlled imaging [ 1 , 2 ] . HMMs [ 31 ] modeled character sequences, SVMs [ 32 ] classified characters, and LeNet [ 33 ] learned recognition features from pixels. FineReader [ 111 ] and Tesseract [ 36 ] supported document OCR, while recognition expanded to handwriting and non-Latin scripts [ 3 , 35 , 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期的光学读取设备包括将印刷图案编码为供听者解释的音符的Optophone(1914年)和Tauschek的模板匹配机(1929年). 商用OCR后来使用标准化字体和控制成像[1,2]. HMMs [31] 建模字符序列,SVMs [32] 分类字符,以及 LeNet [33] 从像素中学习到的识别特征. FineReader [111]和宇宙魔方[36]支持文件OCR,而识别扩展为笔迹和非拉丁文字[3,35,34].

blocks.en: Scene text introduced uncontrolled typography, backgrounds, and lighting. MSER [ 37 ] located stable regions, SWT [ 38 ] exploited consistent stroke width, and Neumann and Matas [ 39 ] connected localization with recognition. PhotoOCR [ 112 ] combined handcrafted features with a deep character classifier, marking a transition toward learned representations.
blocks.zh: 场景文本引入了不受控制的排版,背景,以及照明. MSER[37]位于稳定区域,SWT[38]利用了一致的中风宽度,Neumann和Matas[39]将本地化与识别联系起来。 PhotoOCR [112] 结合了手动特征,带有深层人物分类器,标志着向学习表现的过渡.

blocks.en: II-B Deep Learning Era
blocks.zh: II-B 深入学习时代

blocks.en: Deep learning replaced handcrafted features with learned representations [ 113 , 114 ] . In detection, CTPN [ 115 ] linked local text proposals, EAST [ 40 ] regressed oriented regions, PSENet [ 116 ] and CRAFT [ 117 ] supported irregular text through segmentation, and DBNet [ 41 ] made binarization differentiable.
blocks.zh: 深入学习用学习的表述代替了手工的特色[113,114]. 在检测中,CTPN[115]将当地文本提案联系起来,East [40] 向后退的区域,PSENet [116]和CRAFT[117]通过分割支持不规则文本,DBNet[41]使二进制可以不同.

blocks.en: For cropped text recognition, CRNN [ 23 ] combined CNN, BiLSTM, and CTC. RARE [ 118 ] and ASTER [ 42 ] jointly trained a thin-plate-spline rectifier and an attention-based recognizer using transcription supervision. ABINet [ 119 ] added iterative language modeling; TrOCR [ 43 ] used pretrained vision and language Transformers; and SVTR [ 120 ] replaced the CNN–RNN backbone with a visual Transformer. Training data scale and curation also substantially affect recognition [ 72 , 73 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于裁剪后的文本识别,CRNN [23] 合并CNN,BiLSTM和CTC. RARE [118]和ASTER [42]联合训练了一台薄板螺旋整流器和一台使用抄录监督的注意力识别器. ABINet [119] 增加了迭代语言建模;TrOCR [43] 使用了经过预先训练的视觉和语言变形器;SVTR [120] 以视觉变形器取代了CNN-RN主干线. 培训数据的规模和校准也大大影响了承认[72,73]。

blocks.en: Separately trained detectors and recognizers can duplicate feature extraction, while localization errors affect the image regions available for transcription. End-to-end spotters couple the two tasks through shared features and joint supervision. FOTS [ 44 ] and Mask TextSpotter [ 17 ] combined both tasks in one network; Mask TextSpotter used character segmentation to recognize irregular text. ABCNet [ 121 ] represented curved text with Bezier curves, while DeepSolo [ 45 ] jointly predicted geometry and characters through point queries.
blocks.zh: 单独训练的探测器和识别器可以重复特征提取,而本地化错误则影响可供复制的图像区域. 端对端的监视员通过共同的特征和联合监督来配合这两个任务. FOTS [44] 和 Mask TextSpotter [17] 将两个任务合并为一个网络; Mask TextSpotter 使用字符分割来识别不规则文本. ABCNet [121] 代表带有贝塞尔曲线的曲线文字,而DeepSolo [45] 通过点查询共同预测几何和字符.

blocks.en: Sequence generation further connected localization and recognition through a common output representation. SPTS [ 18 ] generated a point and its transcription for each instance. To reduce the cost of long autoregressive sequences, SPTS v2 [ 46 ] generated instance points first, then recognized instances in parallel with shared decoder parameters. UNITS [ 122 ] used prompts to select points, boxes, or polygons as geometric outputs alongside transcriptions. OmniParser [ 19 ] extended sequence modeling to table recognition and downstream key information extraction (§ III-A ).
blocks.zh: 序列生成通过共同产出代表进一步连接本地化和识别. SBS[18]为每个实例生成了一个点及其抄录。 为了降低长自旋序列的成本,SBS v2[46]首先生成实例点,然后与共享解码器参数平行识别实例. UNITS [122] 使用提示来选择点、框或多边形作为几何输出,同时进行抄写。 OmniParser [19] 扩展序列模型到表识别和下游关键信息提取(§ III-A).

blocks.en: Task-specific recognition continues to develop: CPPD and IPAD study efficient decoding [ 123 , 124 ] ; SMTR addresses text longer than training instances [ 125 ] ; LMIM uses linguistically informed self-supervision [ 126 ] ; UnionST improves text synthesis [ 127 ] ; and WATERec targets artistic typography [ 128 ] . SCUT-EPT highlights long text, editing marks, and noisy backgrounds [ 129 ] . EasyOCR [ 130 ] , docTR [ 131 ] , MMOCR [ 132 ] , and PaddleOCR [ 16 ] package components into multilingual pipelines, with PaddleOCR also covering layout, tables, and formulas.
blocks.zh: 任务特定识别继续发展:CPPD和IPAD研究高效解码[123,124];SMTR处理文本比培训实例长[125];LMIM使用语言上知情的自我监督[126];Union ST改进文本合成[127];和WATERec针对艺术打字[128]. SCUT-EPT突出长文本,编辑标记,以及吵闹的背景 [129]. EasyOCR [130], docTR [131],MCOCR [132],以及PaddleOCR [16] 包组件进入多语种管道,PaddleOCR还涵盖布局,表格和公式.

blocks.en: Document pretraining addressed relationships beyond isolated text recognition. LayoutLM and its successors [ 24 , 133 , 134 ] , DocFormer [ 47 ] , and UDOP [ 48 ] combine upstream OCR text, layout coordinates, and visual features into shared representations for document understanding. OCR supplies the transcriptions, while these models learn how text, position, and appearance interact in downstream tasks. Document reconstruction also requires relating recognized content to its layout. The cost and error propagation of the external OCR stage also motivated direct image-to-sequence approaches such as Donut [ 7 ] (§ III-A ).
blocks.zh: 文件预训涉及的不仅仅是孤立的文本识别。 布局LM及其后继者[24,133,134],DocFormer [47],和UDOP [48] 将上游OCR文本,布局坐标和视觉特征结合到共享的表示中,以便文件理解. OCR提供抄本,而这些模型则学习下游任务中文本,位置,外观如何相互作用. 重建文件还需要将公认的内容与其布局联系起来。 外部OCR舞台的成本和误差传播也激发了直接图像到序列的方法,如Donut [7](第III-A段)。

blocks.en: II-C Lessons and Transition to Generative Parsing
blocks.zh: II-C 经验教训和向基因分析的过渡

blocks.en:
Faithful transcription of a complete page requires accurate local recognition and recovery of the visible structural relations among regions. Errors can therefore arise within individual components and when their outputs are assembled. Modular pipelines offer independently testable and upgradable components, supporting reliability and cost control. Their coordination challenges depend on representation sharing, joint training, and feedback [ 16 , 26 ] .
(1) Error propagation: missed detections or incorrect layout labels can affect later recognition and assembly, while global correction across components is difficult [ 7 , 8 ] .
(2) Training fragmentation: different annotations and objectives complicate page-level optimization; shared encoders and multitask training help reuse data and representations [ 48 ] .
(3) Output integration: coherent documents require aligning regions, text, reading order, hierarchy, and specialized markup through interfaces and postprocessing [ 20 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
忠实地抄写完整一页需要准确的当地认识和恢复各区域之间的可见结构关系。 因此,个别组成部分内部及其产出组装时可能出现错误。 模块管提供独立可测试和可升级的组件,支持可靠性和成本控制. 它们的协调挑战取决于代表分享、联合培训和反馈[16、26]。
(1)错误传播:错失检测或错误的布局标签可能影响以后的识别和组装,而全球各组件的校正则很困难[7,8].
(2)培训不成体系:不同的说明和目标使页面级别优化复杂化;共享编码器和多任务培训有助于重复使用数据和表示 [48].
(3)输出集成:一致的文档需要通过接口和后处理对区域,文本,阅读顺序,等级进行校正,并进行专门的标注[20,8].

blocks.en: The Deep Learning Era brought both learned representations and closer integration of OCR tasks. Joint text spotters reduce detection–recognition handoffs [ 44 , 45 ] , while sequence prediction connects locations and transcriptions in a common output. The Foundation Model Era builds on these developments through large-scale pretraining and shared generation across more content types and document structures. Whole-page generation and layout-guided regional generation organize this integration differently (Section III ).
blocks.zh: " 深入学习时代 " 既带来了学到的表述,也使OCR任务更加紧密地融合。 联合文本显示器减少检测-识别传递[44,45],而序列预测则在共同输出中连接位置和抄录. 基金会的 " 模型时代 " 通过在更多内容类型和文件结构中进行大规模预训和共享生成,在这些发展的基础上更进一步。 整页生成和布局指导的区域生成以不同方式组织这种一体化(第三节)。

blocks.en: III OCR in the Foundation Model Era
blocks.zh: 三 基金会模型时代的OCR

Each flow represents a family: modular toolkits and task-specific models combine task-specific prediction with modular processing, specialized document VLMs perform full-page generation with a model trained for documents, hybrid workflows scaffold generation with explicit layout analysis and VLM recognition of individual regions, general-purpose VLMs expose transcription through open prompting, and commercial products and managed services expose closed stacks through product interfaces or managed endpoints. Table I lists representative systems.

blocks.en: In the Foundation Model Era, large-scale pretraining supplies visual and language representations that can be reused across OCR tasks. Building on earlier joint prediction and sequence modeling, generative document models recover text, notation, and structure through shared decoders. We examine three aspects of this unification: which tasks share a model, how their outputs represent content and structure, and how inference coordinates the page and its regions. These models can generate whole pages or operate in stages, as in layout prediction followed by regional recognition. We assess these choices through transcription fidelity, spatial and structural recovery, and inference cost, accounting for differences in architecture, training data, and decoding strategy.
blocks.zh: 在"基础模型时代"中,大规模预训提供视觉和语言表现,可以跨OCR任务重复使用. 在早期联合预测和序列模型的基础上,基因文件模型通过共享解码器回收文本,注解和结构. 我们审查了这一统一的三个方面:哪些任务共享一个模式,其产出如何代表内容和结构,以及推断如何协调网页及其区域。 这些模型可以生成整页或分阶段运行,如在布局预测之后再进行区域识别. 我们通过记录真实性、空间和结构恢复、推论成本、建筑差异、培训数据和编解码策略来评估这些选择。

blocks.en: This section traces how generative document parsing emerged (§ III-A ), organizes the current ecosystem into five coexisting system families and analyzes their architectural differences (§ III-B ), examines the data and training pipelines that further differentiate them (§ III-C ), and characterizes the limitations that define the current frontier (§ III-D ). The Generative Parsing track of Fig. 4 charts representative systems from Donut to recent models including OCRVerse [ 10 ] , Unlimited-OCR [ 135 ] , and TeleOCR [ 61 ] .
blocks.zh: 本节追踪基因文件分析的出现(第III-A节),将目前的生态系统组织为五个共存的系统家族并分析它们的建筑差异(第III-B节),审查进一步区分它们的数据和培训管道(第III-C节),并描述界定当前前沿的局限性(第III-D节)。 Fig. 4的基因解析轨迹从Donut到OCRVerse [10],无限制-OCR [135],以及TeleOCR [61]等近代模型的图解代表系统.

blocks.en: III-A Emergence of Generative Document Parsing
blocks.zh: III-A 基因文档解析的出现

blocks.en: Generative document parsing drew on three advances outside OCR. Large-scale pretraining produced transferable representations from unlabeled text [ 136 ] and natural-language supervision of images [ 74 ] ; Vision Transformers [ 137 ] extended Transformer-based pretraining to image patches; and language-model pretraining at scale supplied general-purpose text decoders [ 138 ] , while instruction tuning with human feedback improved their ability to follow user instructions [ 139 ] . These advances expanded the capacity and task coverage of generative OCR.
blocks.zh: 基因文件分析借鉴了OCR以外的三项进展。 大规模预训产生了从无标签文本[136]和图像自然语言监督[74]的可转移表述;Vision Transformers[137]将基于变形器的预训扩展至图像补丁;以及规模语言模型预训提供了通用文本解码器[138],同时指令与人类反馈的调谐提高了他们遵循用户指令的能力[139]. 这些进展扩大了遗传性OCR的能力和任务范围。

blocks.en:
Three developments adapted general-purpose pretrained models to the demands of document OCR.
First, vision encoders reached the resolution that dense document text demands: Swin Transformer [ 49 ] keeps attention cost tractable at page scale through hierarchical windowing, NaViT [ 50 ] processes images at native resolution and aspect ratio, and tiling schemes split a page into subimages so that encoders with a fixed input resolution, such as SigLIP [ 140 ] , can be reused. Earlier encoders designed for scene understanding operated at 224–384 pixels [ 137 , 74 ] and could miss small characters or fine table lines.
Monkey [ 141 ] reused a pretrained encoder on local crops with separate low-rank adapters and a shared resampler, retaining a global image view. TextMonkey [ 142 ] introduced shifted-window attention for communication across windows and resampling guided by similarity to reduce redundant visual tokens.
Second, the vision–language model (VLM) architecture emerged as a general framework for multimodal tasks [ 143 , 144 ] : a vision encoder converts the image into visual tokens, a learned projector aligns them with the embedding space of a pretrained large language model, and the LLM generates text conditioned on them. We use VLM broadly for models that connect visual representations with language generation. The models discussed here include compact encoder–decoder precursors, such as Donut and Nougat, and recent systems built on pretrained LLM decoders. This architecture gave OCR a visual frontend with high capacity and a unified interface for structured generation.
Third, training data for whole pages with structural annotations became available at scale. Rendering markup into images and automatically annotating real documents were established techniques [ 6 , 5 , 92 ] , but they had supplied only markup for cropped regions or layout boxes for individual modules. Whole pages can be paired with transcription or markup sequences through synthetic document generation and alignment of existing PDFs with structured sources [ 51 , 20 ] , or through existing OCR pipelines with quality filtering [ 8 , 76 ] , supporting training on whole pages at scale.
blocks.zh:
三项发展使通用的预先训练模型适应了OCR文件的要求.
首先,视觉编码器达成了一个决议,即稠密的文档文本要求: Swin Transformer [49] 通过分级窗口使注意力成本可按页面比例进行可拉动,NaViT [50] 在原生分辨率和侧面比下处理图像,并用平板方案将一页分割成子图像,这样具有固定输入分辨率的编码器,如SigLIP [140],可以被重用. 早期为场景理解设计的编码器运行于224–384像素[137,74],可能错过小字符或细表线.
Monkey [141]在本地作物上重新使用经过预先训练的编码器,配有单独的低档适配器和共享的复刻器,保留了全局图像视图. TextMonkey [142] 引入了对窗口间通信的转向窗口关注,并在相似性的指导下重印以减少冗余的视觉符号.
第二,远景-语言模型(VLM)架构成为多式联运任务的一般框架[143,144]: 一个视觉编码器将图像转换成视觉符号,一个有学识的投影仪将它们与预先训练的大型语言模型的嵌入空间对齐,LLM生成以它们为条件的文本. 我们广泛使用VLM用于将视觉表现与语言生成联系起来的模型. 这里讨论的模型包括紧凑的编码器-解码器前体,如Donut和Nougat,以及利用预先训练的LLM解码器建造的最近系统。 这种架构赋予OCR一个具有高容量的视觉前端和结构化生成的统一接口.
第三,有结构说明的整页培训数据已成规模。 将标记加成图像和自动标注真实文件的技术[6, 5, 92]已经确立,但它们只为已裁剪的区域提供标记,或为单个模块提供布局框。 整页可以通过合成文件生成和现有PDF与结构化来源的对齐[51,20],或者通过现有的具有质量过滤功能的OCR管道[8,76]来配对,支持整页培训的规模.

blocks.en: Early models that map images to sequences without a separate OCR engine, such as Donut [ 7 ] and Pix2Struct [ 52 ] , provided important technical foundations. Donut used an encoder–decoder architecture with a decoder initialized from multilingual BART for task-specific document understanding. Pix2Struct used HTML generation from screenshots for pretraining across visual and linguistic tasks. Nougat [ 20 ] built on Donut’s architecture to transcribe complete pages of scientific documents. Its target sequence represents both recognized content and document structure.
blocks.zh: 早期将图像映射到没有单独OCR引擎的序列的模型,如Donut [7]和Pix2Struct [52],提供了重要的技术基础. Donut使用一个编码器–解码器架构,其解码器从多语言的BART初始化,用于任务特定文档的理解. Pix2Struct使用来自截图的HTML生成,用于跨视觉和语言任务的预训. Nougat [20] 在Donut的架构上, 其目标序列代表了公认的内容和文档结构.

blocks.en: OmniParser [ 19 ] , introduced in § II-B , unified prediction across document tasks through explicit spatial representations without a pretrained LLM. It used structure points to organize text spotting, key information extraction, and table recognition, followed by separate contour and text decoders. OmniParser V2 [ 53 ] added layout analysis and introduced a shared decoder with separate feedforward branches for structure, localization, and recognition. In its architectural comparison with the same Swin-B backbone, V2 uses 110M parameters versus 144M for OmniParser, with end-to-end text spotting scores of 84.3 versus 84.0 on Total-Text without a lexicon [ 53 ] . This illustrates how partial decoder sharing can reduce model size while preserving text spotting performance. It also used its structured-points-of-thought representation to fine-tune multimodal language models.
blocks.zh: OmniParser [19],在§ II-B中引入,通过没有经过预先训练的LLM的清晰空间表示,对文件任务进行统一预测. 它使用结构点来组织文本的抽查,关键信息提取,以及表格识别,然后是单独的轮廓和文本解码器. OmniParser V2 [53] 添加了布局分析,并引入了一个共享的解码器,其中有单独的向导分支,用于结构,本地化,以及识别. 在与同一Swin-B主干线的建筑对比中,V2采用了110M参数对144M的OmniParser,在Total-Text上端对端文本的分数为84.3对84.0,没有词汇 [53]. 这说明部分解码器共享可以减少模型大小,同时保留文本显示性能. 它还利用其结构化的思考点来微调多式联运模式。

blocks.en: In recent OCR VLMs, task unification also draws on vision–language pretraining and multitask training. HunyuanOCR-1.5, for example, combines transcription and document parsing with downstream question answering and translation in one model [ 57 ] .
blocks.zh: 在最近的OCR VLM中,任务统一还借鉴了视觉-语言预训和多任务训练. 例如,HunyuanOCR-1.5将转录和文档解析与下游问答和翻译合并为一个模式[57].

blocks.en: For complete document reconstruction, whole-page generation places content and structure in a common decoding context. Dense pages, however, may require high input resolution and long output sequences. Layout-guided regional generation [ 80 , 81 , 82 ] addresses these costs by identifying regions and decoding their contents separately, retaining an explicit document assembly stage. These two routes draw on shared generative models and training methods and continue to develop in parallel.
blocks.zh: 对于完整的文档重建,整页生成将内容和结构置于一个共同的解码上下文. 然而,感知页可能需要高输入分辨率和长输出序列. 以布局指导的区域生成[80、81、82]通过确定区域并分别解码其内容,从而解决这些费用,同时保留明确的文件组装阶段。 这两条路线借鉴了共享的基因模型和培训方法,并继续平行发展.

blocks.en: III-B System Architectures and Ecosystem
blocks.zh: 三-B 系统结构和生态系统

blocks.en:
Recent benchmarks and technical reports have begun categorizing today’s coexisting OCR systems into coarse groups such as pipelines, end-to-end systems, and VLMs [ 96 , 98 , 59 ] . A classical detection–recognition pipeline and a hybrid workflow that pairs a layout detector with generative recognizers are both pipelines, yet differ fundamentally in how they produce output; a specialized document VLM and a general-purpose VLM are both “end-to-end,” yet differ in training objective, output consistency, and deployment constraints. We therefore refine the existing groupings into five families by asking two questions of each system.
The first is how recognition and structure are integrated: through task-specific predictions produced within one model or combined by a toolkit or application (Family 1, including joint text spotters and specialized table or formula recognizers); at the region level, where an explicit layout stage selects regions for recognition and subsequent assembly (Family 3); or through structured generation over the whole page (Families 2 and 4).
The second question separates the two families that generate whole pages by training objective: specialized document VLMs trained specifically for document OCR form Family 2, while general-purpose VLMs with OCR as one capability among many form Family 4.
Commercial products and managed services often disclose too little architectural or training detail for reliable placement on either dimension. We therefore treat their delivery model as a separate category (Family 5).
The families describe OCR workflows; task sharing can occur within each family.
Fig. 5 and Table I summarize the five families. The table selects historical landmarks, representative current architectures, and widely deployed platforms, and compares their typical outputs, parameter scale, and availability.
blocks.zh:
最近的基准和技术报告已开始将今天共存的OCR系统分类为粗体组,如管道、端到端系统以及VLM[96、98、59]。 一个古典的检测-识别管道和一个将布局检测器与基因识别器组合在一起的混合工作流程都是管道,但在生产输出方式上却大不相同;一个专门的文件VLM和一个通用的VLM都是“端到端”的,但在培训目标、输出一致性和部署限制方面却有所不同。 因此,我们通过向每个系统提出两个问题,将现有的分组分成五个家庭。
第一是识别和结构如何整合:通过在一个模型内制作或由工具包或应用程序(家庭1,包括联合文本显示器和专门表格或公式识别器)组合的针对具体任务的预测;在区域层面,一个明确的布局阶段选择区域进行识别和随后的组装(家庭3);或通过整个页面的结构化生成(家庭2和4)。
第二个问题通过培训目标将制作整页文件的两个家庭区分开来:为家庭2号文件而专门培训的VLM专门文件,而以家庭4号文件作为多种形式之一的能力的通用VLM通用文件。
商业产品和经管理的服务往往披露的建筑或培训细节太少,难以可靠地放在两个方面。 因此,我们将它们的交付模式作为一个单独的类别(家庭5)处理。
家庭描述OCR工作流程;任务分担可在每个家庭进行.
图5和表 我总结五家. 该表选用历史地标,代表性流体建筑,以及广泛部署的平台,并比较其典型产出,参数规模,可用性.

blocks.en:
Family 1: Modular toolkits and task-specific models. This family includes modular toolkits (Tesseract [ 36 ] , PaddleOCR [ 16 , 145 ] , EasyOCR [ 130 ] , docTR [ 131 ] ) that chain detection, recognition, and postprocessing, as well as task-specific models (SVTR [ 120 ] , UniMERNet [ 93 ] , DocLayout-YOLO [ 146 ] ) and joint text spotters. Such models solve defined recognition or localization tasks and can also serve as building blocks in Family 3.
Their task-specific interfaces commonly support constrained or deterministic decoding: detection–recognition pipelines return text with spatial coordinates, table and formula modules emit structured markup, and layout models produce bounding boxes with category labels.
These systems retain task-specific supervision and output formats and are widely used for stable workloads with clear requirements, where they offer predictable outputs and high throughput. Dedicated recognition remains active alongside OCR with foundation models. On WordArt-Bench, WATERec [ 128 ] substantially outperforms the VLM baselines evaluated under the same protocol, showing the continuing value of data and architectures tailored to the domain for challenging text distributions.
blocks.zh:
家庭 1:模块工具包和任务特定模型. 这个家族包括模块化工具包(Tesseract [36],PaddleOCR [16,145],EasyOCR [130], docTR [131]),用于链式检测,识别和后处理,以及任务特定模型(SVTR [120],UniMERNet [93],DocLayout-YOLO [146])和联合文本显示器. 这种模型可以解决定义的识别或本地化任务,也可以作为家庭3的组成部分.
其任务特定接口通常支持受约束或决定性的解码: 检测 - 识别管道返回带有空间坐标,表格和公式模块的文本会发出结构化的标记,布局模型会产生带有分类标签的边框.
这些系统保留了针对具体任务的监督和产出格式,被广泛用于具有明确要求的稳定工作量,提供可预测的产出和高吞吐量。 专门的承认仍然与OCR和基础模型一起积极进行。 在WordArt-Bench上,WATERec[128]的绩效大大超过同一协议下评价的VLM基线,显示了适合域的数据和架构的持续价值,以挑战文本分布.

blocks.en:
Family 2: Specialized document VLMs. A specialized document VLM, designed or fine-tuned specifically for document OCR, maps page images to structured output (Markdown, HTML, L a T e X , or JSON), directly targeting the requirement for faithful parsing (Table I ).
These systems commonly combine training focused on documents, visual encoding designed for OCR, and a predefined output schema. Structural relations such as heading hierarchy, table boundaries, and reading order are handled within the generative process, with designs ranging from implicit decoding [ 20 ] through chain-of-thought layout [ 59 ] to grounded multitask parsing [ 21 ] . GOT-OCR shares a language decoder across text and notation formats [ 8 ] ; HunyuanOCR-1.5 uses task prompts to generate transcriptions, text coordinates, or document markup [ 57 ] . Unification therefore concerns both shared model parameters and support for different output requirements.
blocks.zh:
家庭 2: VLMs 专门文件. 专门为文档OCR设计或微调的专用文档VLM,将页面图像映射到结构化输出(Markdown,HTML,L a T e X,或JSON),直接针对忠实解析的要求(表一).
这些系统通常将侧重于文件的培训、为OCR设计的视觉编码以及预先定义的输出计划结合起来。 结构关系如标题等级,表界,读取顺序等在基因过程内处理,其设计从隐含的解码[20]到思维的链式布局[59]到基于的多任务解析[21]. Got-OCR 共享一个跨文本和注解格式的语言解码器 [8]; HunyuanOCR-1.5 使用任务提示来生成转录,文本坐标,或文档标记 [57]. 因此,统一既涉及共同的模式参数,也涉及支持不同的产出要求。

blocks.en:
Family 3: Hybrid workflows. These systems bridge Families 1 and 2: an explicit layout stage, run by a dedicated detector (often a Family 1 component) or by the parsing model itself, segments the page into typed regions, and each region is decoded by a VLM recognizer before a postprocessor assembles the results into a structured document [ 63 , 81 , 82 ] .
Working on bounded regions can shorten generation sequences, localize some errors, and make computational cost easier to budget. Reliability depends on layout recall and crop quality: missed or inaccurate regions may produce omissions that subsequent assembly cannot recover.
blocks.zh:
家庭3:混合工作流程. 这些系统连接了Family 1和2:一个明确的布局阶段,由专用探测器(通常是Family 1组件)或解析模型本身运行,将页面分解为打字区域,每个区域在后处理器将结果组装成结构化文件之前由VLM识别器解码 [63, 81, 82].
对受限区域开展工作可以缩短生成序列,将一些错误本地化,使计算成本更容易预算. 可靠性取决于布局召回和作物质量:错失或不准确的区域可能产生后期组装无法恢复的遗漏.

blocks.en: Dolphin (2025) generated the page’s element sequence with a compact encoder–decoder and then parsed the elements in parallel with element-specific prompts [ 153 ] . MonkeyOCR (June 2025) built a hybrid workflow on a pretrained LLM decoder: a dedicated detector predicts the block structure, a 3B VLM recognizes each block, and a relation stage orders the blocks [ 81 ] . dots.ocr (July 2025) took the whole-page route, predicting layout and content with one VLM in a single pass [ 154 ] . Subsequent releases explored smaller recognizers and different degrees of sharing across stages: MinerU2.5 (September 2025) used a 1.2B VLM for layout at reduced resolution and for recognition from crops at native resolution [ 80 ] ; PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 (January 2026) kept the two-stage form with a 0.9B VLM [ 77 ] ; and Dolphin-v2 fine-tuned one VLM for both layout analysis and content parsing, with regional recognition for digital documents and whole-page parsing for photographed ones [ 82 ] . Releases in 2026 kept this structure and moved effort to training and decoding: MinerU2.5-Pro added fine-tuning on difficult samples and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 progressive post-training [ 63 , 62 ] ; MonkeyOCRv2 replaced the reused vision encoder with one pretrained from scratch on document images [ 75 ] (§ III-C ); GLM-OCR and Youtu-Parsing cut sequential decoding steps with multi-token and parallel decoding [ 64 , 83 ] (§ III-D ); and TeleOCR extended the workflow to camera-captured documents [ 61 ] . Recognizers in this family now range from 0.6B to 3B parameters, with most 2026 releases below 1.5B.
blocks.zh: Dolphin(2025)用紧凑的编码器-解码器生成了页面元素序列,然后将元素与元素特定提示平行解析 [153]. 猴猫 (2025年6月)在预训LLM解码器上搭建混合工作流程:专用探测器预测区块结构,3B VLM识别每个区块,关系级命令区块[81]. dots.ocr (2025年7月)采取整页路线,以单行道1个VLM预测布局和内容[154]. 随后的发行探索了较小的识别器和不同程度的跨阶段共享:MinerU2.5(2025年9月)使用1.2B VLM进行低分辨率布局,并用原生分辨率[80]用于作物的识别;PaddleOCR-VL-1.5(2026年1月)将双阶段形式保留在0.9B VLM [77];Dolphin-v2对一个VLM进行了微调,用于布局分析和内容解析,对数字文件进行区域识别,对照片进行整页解析[82]。 2026年的发布保持了这一结构,并努力进行了培训和解码:MinerU2.5-Pro增加了对困难样品的微调,PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 渐进式训练后[63,62];MonkeyOCRv2将复用视觉编码器更换为文件图像上一个从头开始的预训[75](§ III-C);GLM-OCR和Youtu-Parsing用多键和平行解码器剪接顺序解码步骤[64,83](§ III-D);以及TeleOCR将工作流程扩展到相机文件[61]. 这个家族的识别器现在从0.6B到3B参数不等,大多数2026年的释放低于1.5B.

blocks.en:
Family 4: General-purpose VLMs. General-purpose VLMs (GPT-6 [ 68 ] , Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 65 ] , Qwen3.8 [ 66 ] , InternVL3.5 [ 67 ] ) are trained for broad understanding of visual and linguistic content, with OCR as one capability among many.
These models support transcription through prompts, alongside applications such as question answering about images and semantic field extraction. The share of documents in their training mixtures is generally undisclosed. On OmniDocBench v1.6_full, the general-purpose VLMs on the official leaderboard span 83.76 to 93.70 Overall, from InternVL3.5-241B to Ovis2.6-30B-A3B, and the strongest of them falls within the 93.26–96.91 range of the specialized and hybrid systems in Table VI [ 155 ] .
blocks.zh:
家庭4:通用VLMs. 通用VLMs(GPT-6 [68],双子座3.1 Pro [65],Quen3.8 [66],InternVL3.5 [67])接受培训,以广泛理解视觉和语言内容,其中OCR是许多人的一种能力.
这些模型通过提示支持转录,同时支持应用如关于图像的问答和语义字段提取. 其培训混合物中的文件份额一般不公开。 在OmniDoc Bench v1.6_full上,官方领导板上的通用VLM横跨83.76至93.70. 总体而言,从InternVL3.5-241B到Ovis2.6-30B-A3B,其中最强者属于表六中的93.26-96.91专业系统和混合系统范围[155].

blocks.en: Family 5: Commercial products and managed services. Commercial products and managed services (ABBYY, Mathpix, TextIn, Mistral OCR 4 [ 69 ] , Google Document AI [ 70 ] , Azure [ 71 ] ) typically emphasize operational reliability, format control, integration support, and enterprise deployment features. Where documentation describes the processing, it maps onto the preceding families: Document AI and Azure AI Document Intelligence expose separate reading, layout, and form or table processors in the manner of Family 1 toolkits, while Mistral OCR 4 serves one document model that returns Markdown and JSON.
blocks.zh: 家庭5:商业产品和管理服务。 商业产品与管理服务(ABBYY, Mathpix, TextIn, Mistral OCR 4 [69],Google Document AI [70],Azure [71])通常强调操作可靠性,格式控制,集成支持,以及企业部署功能. 在文件描述处理时,它绘制在前几家的地图: 文件AI和Azure AI文档智能以Family 1工具包的方式暴露了单独的读取,布局,形式或表格处理器,而Mistral OCR 4则服务于一个文件模型,可以返回Markdown和JSON.

blocks.en: III-C Data and Training Pipelines
blocks.zh: 数据和培训管道

blocks.en: The capabilities of each system family depend on both its architecture and the data and training signals from which those capabilities are learned. Fig. 6 compares these two dimensions across the four trainable families. Local transcription labels supervise recognition, while page reconstruction also requires reading order, hierarchy, and relations between elements.
blocks.zh: 每个系统家族的能力取决于其结构以及学习这些能力的数据和培训信号。 图6比较了四个可培训家庭的这两个层面。 本地的抄写标签监督识别,而页面重建也需要阅读顺序,层次,元素之间的关系.

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Data sources (left) and training pipelines (right) for the first four system families. Modular toolkits and task-specific models use task-specific data and supervision; specialized document VLMs use pages and region crops for pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and optional reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards; hybrid workflows train separate layout and recognition models or a shared VLM for both tasks; and general-purpose VLMs use broad multimodal corpora with alignment, joint pretraining, instruction tuning, and optional post-training.
blocks.zh: 图6:数据来源(左)和培训管道(右) 前四个系统家庭。 模块化工具包和任务专用模型使用任务专用数据和监督;专业文档VLM使用页面和区域作物进行预训,有监督的微调,以及可可核查奖励的可选强化学习;混合工作流程为两项任务分别培训布局和识别模式或共享VLM;通用VLM使用广泛的多模式公司,并配有对齐,联合预训,教学调和,以及可选的后培训.

blocks.en:
Data quantity and quality are established performance variables in scene text recognition [ 72 , 73 ] , and the four trainable families draw on progressively broader data (Fig. 6 , left).
Family 1 trains each module on task-specific data : scene text images, word and line crops, pages with layout annotations, table crops, and formula crops. Public corpora range from roughly 10 5 10^{5} annotated pages or formulas to nearly 10 7 10^{7} synthetic word images per task [ 6 , 156 , 92 , 5 ] .
Family 2 assembles data centered on documents , with reported training mixtures spanning several million to tens of millions of page and region image–text pairs [ 7 , 20 , 8 , 157 ] . These data combine full pages with region crops through synthetic rendering [ 51 ] , engine bootstrapping, deduplication using CLIP [ 74 ] , quality filtering, and curriculum schedules.
Family 3 combines layout annotations (pages with layout labels and bounding boxes) with cropped regions paired with transcription targets. Representative systems report several million to several tens of millions of mixed training samples, while their subsets for layout supervision range from tens of thousands to a few million pages [ 81 , 80 , 77 ] .
Family 4 trains on broad multimodal corpora spanning photographs, charts, conversations, code, and documents, where document understanding is one of many target capabilities. Open technical reports describe hundreds of billions to several trillion pretraining tokens, followed by roughly one to tens of millions of supervised multimodal examples [ 158 , 159 , 160 ] ; the proportions of documents are generally undisclosed.
blocks.zh:
数据数量和质量是在现场文本识别[72,73]中确定的性能变量,四个可训练家庭利用逐渐扩大的数据(图6,左)。
Family 1在任务特定数据上培训每个模块:场景文本图像、文字和线条作物、附有布局说明的页面、桌子作物和公式作物。 公共公司从大约10 5 10^{5}注解页或公式到近10 7 10^{7}每个任务合成单词图像[6,156,92,5].
Family 2 组装了以文件为中心的数据,据报告,培训混合物的页数为数百万至数千万,区域图像为对[7、20、8、157]。 这些数据通过合成渲染[51]、发动机拖带、使用CLIP[74]的分解、质量过滤和课程表将全页与区域作物结合起来。
家庭3将布局说明(页加布局标签和边框)与作物区域与抄写目标对齐. 代表性系统报告有数百万至数千万混合培训样本,其用于布局监督的子集从成千上万页到几百万页[81、80、77]页不等。
家庭4号列车使用广泛的多模式编组,跨越照片、图表、对话、代码和文件,其中文件理解是许多目标能力之一。 公开技术报告描述了数千亿至几万亿的预先训练标志,随后是大约一至几千万个受监督的多式联运实例[158、159、160];文件比例一般没有披露。

blocks.en:
Training methods also diverge across families (Fig. 6 , right).
Family 1 uses task-specific supervision : CTC or token cross-entropy for recognizers [ 23 , 120 ] , and detection or layout losses for other modules [ 41 , 92 ] . Components may be trained separately, while end-to-end spotters share features and jointly optimize localization and recognition [ 17 , 18 ] .
Family 2 is typically trained in two stages, pretraining for alignment between document images and text followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on document tasks covering text fidelity, table structure, and formula syntax; a growing number of systems add a third stage of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) that exploits OCR’s distinctive property of producing verifiable outputs. These objectives include rewards from executable unit tests for text presence and absence, reading order, tables, formulas, and abnormal repetition in olmOCR2 [ 76 ] and rewards that account for output format [ 79 ] .
Family 3 uses either separate models or a shared VLM for layout analysis and recognition. With separate models, the layout detector is trained on annotated pages, while region parsers follow Family 2’s training pipeline or are reused from existing models. Dolphin-v2 fine-tunes the same VLM for both layout analysis and content parsing [ 82 ] . PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 also uses group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to reduce inconsistency in output style [ 77 , 78 ] . With its 1.2B architecture fixed, MinerU2.5-Pro improves table TEDS on OmniDocBench v1.6 from 90.37 to 92.87 by adding supervised fine-tuning on hard examples mixed with earlier training data [ 63 ] .
Within Family 3, MonkeyOCRv2 pretrains standalone ViT-Small/Base encoders from scratch on document images, using text and pixel reconstruction decoders that share the visual tokens [ 75 ] . For parsing, it freezes the encoder and connects it to Qwen3-0.6B through an MLP projector. At a long-side input resolution of 448 pixels, adding pixel reconstruction during pretraining raises its S-Parsing pipeline’s recognition accuracy on scrambled text from 55.4% to 72.1%, showing gains when linguistic context is disrupted [ 75 ] .
Family 4 follows a pipeline with four stages: visual alignment (connector warmup), joint pretraining on multimodal and text data, SFT via instruction tuning, and optional post-training with direct preference optimization (DPO), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), or RLVR.
In downstream document question answering, DocThinker [ 161 ] uses rule-based reinforcement learning with rewards for answer correctness, supporting-region localization, question reformulation, and output format.
blocks.zh:
培训方法也因家庭而异(图6,右)。
家庭1采用特定任务监督: 用于识别器的CTC或标志性交叉收缩[23,120],以及其他模块的检测或布局损失[41,92]. 组件可以单独培训,而端对端的检测器则共享特征,共同优化本地化和识别[17,18].
家庭2通常分两个阶段培训,先对文件图像和文本进行校正培训,然后对文件任务进行有监督的微调(SFT),涉及文本的忠实性、表格结构和公式语法;越来越多的系统增加了可核查奖励的强化学习的第三阶段,利用OCR独特的特性生产可核查产出。 这些目标包括可执行单元测试对文本存在和缺失的奖励,读取顺序,表格,公式,以及olmOCR2[76]中异常重复的奖励,以及计算输出格式的奖励[79].
Family 3使用独立的模型或共享的VLM进行布局分析和识别. 使用不同的模型,布局探测器在附加说明的页面上进行训练,而区域剖析器则遵循Family 2的训练管道或从现有模型中重新使用. Dolphin-v2对相同的VLM进行微调,用于布局分析和内容解析[82]. PaddleOCR-VL-1.5还采用组类相对政策优化(GRPO)来减少产出风格的不一致[77,78]. MinerU2.5-Pro在固定1.2B架构后,改进了OmniDoc Bench v1.6上的表TEDS,从90.37到92.87,在硬例子上增加了有监督的微调,与早期的培训数据混合[63]。
在Family 3中,MonkeyOCRv2预置独立ViT-Small/Base编码器从文件图像上抓取,使用文本和像素重建解码器共享视觉符号[75]. 对于解析,它会冻结编码器,并通过MLP投影仪将其连接到Quen3-0.6B. 在448像素的长边输入解析度中,在预训期间添加像素重建,使其S-Parsing管道在拼音文本上的识别精度从55.4%提高到72.1%,在语言环境中断时显示增益[75].
家庭4遵循一个分四个阶段的管道:视觉对接(连接热身),多式联运和文本数据联合预训,通过教学调谐的SFT,以及直接优化偏好(DPO)的选择性后培训,从人类反馈中强化学习(RLHF)或RLVR.
在下游文档问答中,DocThinker [161] 使用基于规则的强化学习,并奖励答案正确性,支持区域本地化,问题重构,以及输出格式.

blocks.en: III-D Current Limitations
blocks.zh: 三-D 当前的限制

blocks.en: Families 2–4 generate output conditioned on the image. Learned linguistic and layout regularities should support recovery of the content in the source image, but when compression, limited resolution, or unfamiliar layouts weaken the visual evidence, generation may rely on learned priors, producing unsupported content or omitting difficult regions. Localization, reading order, and relations across regions add requirements beyond recognizing the text, and high input resolution with long structured outputs increases computation. Multilingual text and documents with many pages combine these difficulties.
blocks.zh: 家庭 2–4 生成以图像为条件的输出. 学到的语言和布局规律应支持源图像中内容的恢复,但当压缩,有限分辨率,或不熟悉的布局削弱视觉证据时,生成可能依赖于学到的前科,产生不支持的内容或省略困难区域. 本地化、阅读顺序和跨区域的关系除了承认文本之外,还增加了要求,而且结构化产出较长的高投入分辨率增加了计算。 多种语文文本和多页文件将这些困难结合在一起。

blocks.en: Hallucination and omission can arise when visual detail is lost, complex layouts are only partly covered, or decoding errors accumulate in long sequences [ 7 , 8 , 96 ] . Published evaluations report fabricated text and phantom table rows, as well as omissions, collapsed columns, and incorrect heading levels [ 96 , 98 ] . MinerU2.5, MonkeyOCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and Dolphin-v2 use layout analysis and parsing of individual regions to shorten generation sequences and preserve local detail [ 80 , 81 , 77 , 82 ] ; MinerU2.5-Pro and olmOCR2 strengthen output fidelity through data verification and executable rewards [ 63 , 76 ] . The olmOCR2 study reports that a data loader bug excluded blank pages from training and caused hallucinations on blank inputs, an error that benchmark scores did not register, since fixing it and retraining left them unchanged [ 76 ] .
blocks.zh: 当视觉细节丢失,复杂布局仅部分覆盖,或者解码错误在长序中累积[7,8,96]时,可能出现幻觉和疏漏. 公布的评价报告捏造了文字和幽灵表行,以及遗漏,柱子倒塌,标题级别不正确[96,98]. MinerU2.5,MonkeyOCR,PaddleOCR-VL,和Dolphin-v2 利用对各个区域的布局分析和解析,缩短生成序列,并保存局部细节[80,81,77,82]; MinerU2.5-Pro和olmOCR2通过数据核实和可执行的奖励加强输出忠性[63,76]. olmOCR2研究报告称,一个数据加载器错误将空白页排除在培训之外,并导致空白输入出现幻觉,这个错误基准分数没有记录,因为修复和再培训使其保持不变[76].

blocks.en: Spatial grounding associates each output element, such as text, a formula, a table, or a layout block, with its region in the source image through a bounding box, coordinates, or a region identifier. It makes generated content verifiable against the image and supports reconstruction of reading order, hierarchy, and relations across regions. Its precision is bounded by the visual detail the encoder retains and by coordinate quantization in the output [ 21 , 59 ] . Benchmark evaluations show that general-purpose VLMs remain limited in text localization, layout perception, and parsing of complex elements [ 95 ] , and plain Markdown, HTML, or L a T e X output generally omits the correspondence between elements and image regions altogether [ 20 , 8 ] . Hybrid workflows add explicit structure: MonkeyOCR separates structure detection, region recognition, and reading-order prediction through its Where–What–How formulation [ 81 ] ; Dolphin-v2 uses absolute coordinates and layout anchors to improve crop precision; and PaddleOCR-VL predicts regions defined by multiple points jointly with reading order and grounded text spotting [ 82 , 77 ] .
blocks.zh: 空间定位将每个输出元素,如文本,公式,表格,或布局块联系起来,通过边框,坐标,或区域标识符将其区域置于源图像中. 它使生成的内容可以与图像相对应,并支持跨区域阅读秩序、等级和关系的重建。 其精度以编码器保留的视觉细节和输出[21,59]中的坐标量化为界. 基准评价显示,通用VLM在文本本地化,布局感知,以及解析复杂元素[95]方面仍然有限,Plain Markdown, HTML,或L a T e X输出一般都忽略了元素和图像区域之间的对应[20,8]. 混合工作流程增加明确结构: MonkeyOCR通过其结构检测、区域识别和读序预测分离 Where–What–How Production [81];海豚V2使用绝对坐标和布局锚点来提高作物精度;PaddleOCR-VL预测由多个点共同定义的区域与读取顺序和定点文本抽查[82,77].

blocks.en: Inference cost arises from visual input at high resolution and from long structured output: dense pages produce many visual tokens, and generating one token at a time introduces latency that grows with output length. GLM-OCR combines multi-token prediction with parallel region recognition [ 64 ] , Youtu-Parsing introduces token parallelism and query parallelism over shared page features [ 83 ] , and P-MTP progressively increases lookahead depth and dynamically selects speculative lengths during inference [ 84 ] . Parallel processing of regions and multi-token decoding reduce sequential generation steps, while layout processing, scheduling, verification, and assembly add system overhead.
blocks.zh: 推论成本来自高分辨率的视觉输入和长期结构化的输出:密集的页面产生许多视觉符号,一次生成一个符号会引入随输出长度增长的耐久性. GLM-OCR将多键预测与平行区域识别相结合[64],Youtu-Parsing在共享的页面功能上引入了符号平行主义和查询平行主义[83],P-MTP在推论中逐渐增加外观深度,动态选择投机长度[84]. 平行处理区域和多托肯解码会减少顺序生成步骤,而布局处理,调度,核查,和组装则会增加系统间接费用.

blocks.en: Language coverage expanded in the earlier eras through dedicated datasets: CASIA-HWDB and IFN/ENIT for Chinese and Arabic handwriting [ 34 , 162 ] , the ICDAR 2019 MLT challenge for detection and recognition across ten languages in scene images [ 163 ] , and XFUND for form understanding in seven languages [ 164 ] . Generative parsers inherit their coverage from the pretrained language model and from the documents added in fine-tuning (§ III-C ), and evaluations show where it falls short: the question-answering benchmark MTVQA reports low accuracy of leading VLMs on text-centric questions in nine languages [ 165 ] , CC-OCR includes a multilingual reading track [ 166 ] , and MDPBench reports diacritic omissions, character substitutions across writing systems, and errors in ordering text from right to left in document parsing [ 85 ] .
blocks.zh: 语言覆盖范围在早期通过专用数据集扩展:CASIA-HWDB和IFN/ENIT用于汉字和阿拉伯语笔迹[34,162],ICDAR 2019 MLT挑战在现场图像中通过10种语言进行检测和识别[163],XFUND用于7种语言的形式理解[164]. Generative parasers从预先训练的语言模型和在微调中添加的文件(§ III-C)中继承了他们的覆盖范围,评价显示其不足之处:问答基准MTVQA报告主要VLM在9种语言的文字中心问题上的精度较低[165],CC-OCR包括多语种读音轨[166],MDP Bench报告有批评疏漏,字符替换跨写系统,在文件解析中将文本从右到左排列错误[85].

blocks.en: Most parsing benchmarks and training data use single pages (Table II ). A document with many pages requires continuing paragraphs and tables across page breaks, recovering a heading hierarchy over the whole document, and maintaining reading order across pages, while visual tokens and output length accumulate with page count. MPDocBench-Parse evaluates these requirements and reports weaknesses in merging content across pages and in recovering hierarchy [ 86 ] . Long-document understanding also addresses the cost of processing many pages: DUDE and MMLongBench-Doc pose questions whose evidence is spread over many pages [ 167 , 168 ] , PDF-WuKong parses the document into text and image blocks and then selects evidence by sparse sampling conditioned on the query [ 87 ] , and DocSeeker learns to locate evidence pages through distilled supervision and reinforcement learning [ 169 ] .
blocks.zh: 大多数分析基准和培训数据使用单页(表二)。 具有许多页面的文档需要跨页面间隔段段和表格的连续性,恢复整个文档的标题层次,并保持页面之间的阅读顺序,而可视化符号和输出长度则随页数累积。 MPDoc Bench-Parse评价了这些要求,并报告了在将内容跨页合并和恢复等级方面存在的缺陷[86]. 长期文件理解还涉及处理许多页的成本:DUDE和MMLong Bench-Doc提出其证据分布在许多页的问题[167,168],PDF-WuKong将文件分为文字和图像块,然后通过查询中以少量抽样条件选择证据[87],DocSeeker学习通过提炼监督和强化学习查找证据页[169].

blocks.en: IV Evolution of OCR Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 四. OCR基准的演变

blocks.en: The system evolution of Section III changed what OCR benchmarks must measure. The required output has grown from a class label or a character string to a structured reconstruction of a whole page or document, with locations, reading order, tables, formulas, and markup returned together. Evaluation followed this growth in stages, each opened when systems outgrew the measure before it, and none closed by its successors. Section IV-A traces the five stages; Section IV-B reads published results as of October 2026 against them.
blocks.zh: 第三节的系统演变改变了OCR基准必须衡量的内容。 所需的输出已经从类标签或字符串发展到整个页面或文档的结构化重建,位置,读取顺序,表格,公式,并一起返回标记. 评估是随着这种增长分阶段进行的,每个系统在超过它面前的计量时打开,没有一个系统被其继任者关闭。 第四节A部分追踪了五个阶段;第四节B部分阅读了截至2026年10月针对它们公布的结果。

blocks.en: IV-A How OCR Benchmarks Evolved
blocks.zh: 四-A OCR基准如何演变

blocks.en: Five stages trace this development (Fig. 7 and Table II ): the input expands from isolated characters to complete documents, and the output from class labels through region transcripts and component structures to full-document markup.
blocks.zh: 五个阶段追踪这一发展(图7和表二):输入从孤立的字符扩展为完成文档,通过区域记录和组件结构从类标签输出为全文档标记.

blocks.en: The first stage tested controlled text recognition . MNIST [ 33 ] reduced the problem to classifying single digits, while IAM [ 170 ] and CASIA-HWDB [ 34 ] extended evaluation to handwritten characters and complete text lines. These protocols receive the text already located and cropped; finding it defined the next stage.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段测试了控制文本识别 。 MNIST [33] 将问题简化为对单位数进行分类,而IAM [170] 和 CASIA-HWDB [34] 则将评价扩展到手写字符和完整文本行. 这些协议收到已经找到并裁剪的文本;发现它定义了下一阶段.

blocks.en: The second stage brought OCR into natural scenes. The ICDAR Robust Reading competitions [ 171 , 89 ] and later datasets such as Total-Text [ 90 ] and CTW1500 [ 91 ] established protocols for scene text detection and end-to-end spotting , and word-crop benchmarks IIIT5K [ 172 ] , SVT [ 88 ] , SVTP [ 173 ] , and CUTE80 [ 174 ] isolated scene text recognition . Video text was probed through the ICDAR 2013 video challenge [ 171 ] and BOVText [ 175 ] . The unit of judgment remained the word or region; HierText [ 176 ] grouped words into lines and paragraphs, while tables, formulas, and page-level structure stayed outside these protocols.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段将OCR带入自然场景. ICDAR强力阅读比赛[171,89]以及后来的数据集,如Total-Text [90]和CTW1500 [91] 建立了场景文本检测和端对端的抽查协议,以及词谱基准IIIT5K [172],SVT [88],SVTP [173],以及CUTE80 [174]孤立场景文本识别. 视频文本通过ICDAR 2013视频挑战[171]和BOVText [175] 进行了探测. 判断单位仍然是单词或区域; HierText [176] 将单词组合成行和段落,而表格、公式和页级结构则不在这些协议中。

blocks.en: The third stage, document structure components , brought structure into the metric, one component at a time. PubTabNet [ 5 ] evaluated table structure as HTML with TEDS, FinTabNet [ 177 ] paired cell boxes with logical row–column structure and evaluated cell adjacency, and CROHME [ 178 ] and UniMER-Test [ 93 ] evaluated formula recognition under structural or L a T e X conventions. Layout benchmarks followed a different contract: PubLayNet [ 92 ] and DocLayNet [ 179 ] formulate the task as localization and classification of predefined page regions and report mAP within their respective label spaces. Each component is scored under its own definition of structure, with no shared protocol across components.
blocks.zh: 第三阶段是文件结构组成部分,将结构纳入衡量标准,一次一个组成部分。 PubTabNet [5] 与TEDS、FinTabNet [177] 配对的带逻辑行-列结构的单元格框和评价单元格的辅助性,以及CROHME [178] 和UniMER-Test [93] 在结构或L T e X常规下评价公式识别。 布局基准遵循了不同的合同:PubLayNet[92]和DocLayNet[179]制定任务,将预定义的页面区域定位和分类,并在各自的标签空间内报告mAP. 每个组成部分都根据其自身的结构定义打分,各组成部分之间没有共同的协议。

blocks.en: The fourth stage, document understanding , judges systems by their answers. DocVQA [ 13 ] , ChartQA [ 94 ] , and DUDE [ 167 ] pair document images with natural language questions, while FUNSD [ 180 ] and CORD [ 181 ] target key information extraction. These downstream benchmarks evaluate answer or field accuracy and have influenced VLM system design.
blocks.zh: 第四阶段,文件理解,通过答案判断系统。 DocVQA [13], ChartQA [94],以及DUDE [167] 配对的带有自然语言问题的文档图像,而FUNSD [180]和CORD [181] 瞄准关键信息提取. 这些下游基准评价答案或实地准确性,并影响了VLM系统设计.

blocks.en: The fifth stage, OCR evaluation in the Foundation Model Era , returned to reconstruction and divides into two tracks. OCRBench [ 11 ] and OCRBench v2 [ 95 ] diagnose VLM abilities across transcription, localization, and understanding tasks. OmniDocBench [ 96 , 155 ] , Real5-OmniDocBench [ 97 ] , PureDocBench [ 98 ] , MDPBench [ 85 ] , and MPDocBench-Parse [ 86 ] evaluate reconstruction of complete pages and multipage documents across content fidelity, reading order, and document structure, placing multiple system families on shared pages while retaining metrics for individual components. With this stage the unit of evaluation caught up with the unit of system output: the page, and most recently the document.
blocks.zh: 第五个阶段,即基金会模型时代的OCR评价,恢复重建,分为两条轨道。 OCR Bench [11] 和 OCR Bench v2 [95] 诊断VLM能力 跨越抄录,本地化,理解任务. OmniDoc Bench [96,155],Real5-OmniDoc Bench [97],PureDoc Bench [98],MDP Bench [85],以及MPDoc Bench-Parse [86]评价内容忠诚度,阅读顺序和文件结构的完整页面和多页文档的重建,将多个系统家族放在共享页面上,同时保留单个组件的度量. 在这一阶段,评价单位赶上了系统输出单位:网页,最近是文件。

blocks.en: IV-B What the Benchmarks Reveal
blocks.zh: 四B类 基准的启示

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Quantitative Performance Trends
blocks.zh: IV-B 1 量化业绩趋势

blocks.en: Published results show high scores on several common OCR benchmarks, with small recent gains on the selected scene text benchmarks. Table structure within pages and physical capture conditions still distinguish systems.
blocks.zh: 公布的结果显示,在几个共同的OCR基准上得分很高,在选定的场景文本基准上最近略有进展。 页面内的表格结构与物理捕捉条件仍然能区分系统.

blocks.en: Scene text. CTW1500 detection Hmean increased from 75.6 for TextSnake to 88.5 for TPD-STR; under the MJ+ST setting, IIIT5K recognition accuracy increased from 82.9 for CRNN to 97.7 for SVTRv2; and Total-Text F1 without a lexicon increased from 65.3 for Mask TextSpotter v2 to 84.6 for TiCLS (Tables III – V ). From the 2022 entries to the latest ones, the gains are 1.4, 0.7, and 1.0 points: most of the distance was covered within the Deep Learning Era, and the open problems moved to harder text distributions and to full pages.
blocks.zh: 场景文字. CTW1500检测Hmean从TextSnake的75.6升至TPD-STR的88.5;在MJ+ST设置下,IIIT5K识别精度从CRNN的82.9升至SVTRv2的97.7;没有词汇的Total-Text F1从Mask TextSpotter v2的65.3升至TiCLS的84.6(表三-五). 从2022年的条目到最新的条目,收益分别为1.4,0.7和1.0分: 距离的大部分被覆盖在"深度学习时代"中,开放问题转移到更硬的文本分发和满页.

blocks.en: Document structure components. Reported scores are also high on several document structure benchmarks. Reported TEDS scores include 88.3 for EDD on the original PubTabNet test set [ 5 ] and 96.3 for TableMASTER on the ICDAR 2021 test split [ 219 ] ; the different test sets prevent a direct estimate of improvement. On PubLayNet, reported mAP includes 91.0 for Mask R-CNN in the RoDLA evaluation [ 220 ] and 96.2 for VGT [ 221 ] , and UniMERNet reached 96.8 CDM on UniMER-Test in a 2025 metric study [ 101 ] . These scores characterize individual components; full-page benchmarks additionally assess how their outputs preserve reading order and relations between elements.
blocks.zh: 文件结构组成部分。 一些文件结构基准的成绩也很高。 报告的TEDS分数包括原PubTabNet测试集的88.3分EDD分数[5]和ICDAR 2021测试分数上的TableMASTER分数96.3分;不同的测试集防止直接估计改进. 在PubLayNet上,所报告的mAP在RoDLA评价[220]和VGT[221]的96.2中为Mask R-CNN列入了91.0,UIMERNet在2025年的一项计量研究中达到了96.8 CDM on UnimER-Test. [101]. 这些分数是各组成部分的特点;全页基准还评估其产出如何维护阅读秩序和各组成部分之间的关系。

blocks.en: VLM OCR diagnostics. Shared diagnostic suites measure the reading ability that general-purpose VLMs expose through prompts. Selected OCRBench results range from 736 for GPT-4o to 931 for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B [ 11 , 222 ] , an increase of 195 points that leaves the leading score 69 points below the nominal ceiling of 1,000. The total aggregates 1,000 question-level judgments spanning text recognition, scene-text and document question answering, key information extraction, and handwritten mathematical expression recognition [ 11 ] , so a change in the total cannot be attributed to any single ability, and reconstruction of complete pages lies outside the task set.
blocks.zh: VLM OCR诊断. 共用诊断套房通过提示测量通用甚高频的读取能力。 选定的OCR Bench成绩从GPT-4o的736分到Qwen3.5-397B-A17B的931分不等[11,222],增加了195分,使得领先的得分低于名义上限1000分的69分. 总计1 000个问题层面的判断,涉及文本识别、场景文本和文档问答、关键信息提取和手写数学表达识别[11],因此,总数的变化不能归因于任何单一能力,完整页面的重建位于任务设定之外。

blocks.en: Parsing complete pages. Benchmarks for parsing complete pages evaluate reconstruction under a common output protocol. On OmniDocBench v1.6_full, the selected results span 93.26–96.91 Overall, 95.60–97.35 for text, 88.04–96.82 for tables, and 95.08–97.53 for formulas (Table VI ) [ 155 , 58 , 61 ] . Text scores of the eight systems lie within 1.75 points of one another, and table scores spread over 8.78 points, so tables are the component that still separates them. TeleOCR and OvisOCR2 hold the top two positions, one from layout-guided regional generation and one from whole-page generation. Every system above 95 Overall has at most 1.2B parameters, while the 2B to 4B systems score at most 94.00. Within these selected results, the choice between the two designs does not decide the ranking, and larger models do not rank higher.
blocks.zh: 解析完整页面 。 分析完整页面的基准根据共同产出协议评价重建。 在OmniDoc Bench v1.6_full上,所选结果总共为93.26-96.91,文本为95.60-97.35,表格为88.04-96.82,公式为95.08-97.53(表六)[155、58、61]。 8个系统的文字分数位于彼此的1.75分之内,表的分数分布在8.78分之间,因此表格是仍然将它们分开的成分. TeleOCR和OvisOCR2占据了前两个位置,一个来自布局引导的区域生成,一个来自整页生成. 每个超过95的系统总参数最多有1.2B参数,而2B至4B的系统得分最高为94.00. 在这些选定的结果中,两种设计之间的选择不能决定排名,较大的模型也不会排名更高.

blocks.en: Physical robustness. Real5-OmniDocBench evaluates scanning, warping, screen photography, illumination change, and skew over the same 1,355 source pages from OmniDocBench v1.5. Across the selected systems on its current official leaderboard, overall scores span 64.45–93.19 (Table VII ) [ 216 ] . The modular toolkit PP-StructureV3 falls from 84.68 on scans to 37.98 under skew, while every listed generative system stays above 85 in all five conditions, and their overall scores lie within 4.2 points of one another. Each image is a re-capture of one source page under a single acquisition condition [ 97 ] , so documents that exist only as camera captures lie outside the benchmark’s coverage.
blocks.zh: 身体坚固. Real5-OmniDoc Bench评价扫描,warping,屏幕摄影,照明变化,并浏览OmniDoc Bench v1.5的相同1,355个源页. 在其目前正式领导板上的选定系统中,总得分为64.45-93.19(表七)[216]。 模块化工具包PP-StructureV3在扫描中从84.68位降至37.98位,而在全部五个条件下,每个列出的基因系统都保持在85位以上,它们的总体得分都在4.2分之间. 每个图像都是在一个单一获取条件[97]下一个源页的复写,因此仅作为相机捕获而存在的文件就位于基准覆盖范围之外.

blocks.en: IV-B 2 What Current Metrics Miss
blocks.zh: IV-B 2 当前的计量差错

blocks.en: Across protocols, interpretation is limited by three recurring issues: differences in output definitions and matching rules, aggregation across heterogeneous components, and incomplete coverage of content, document conditions, and reconstruction errors.
blocks.zh: 在整个协议中,解释受到三个反复出现的问题的限制:产出定义和匹配规则的差异、不同组成部分的汇总、内容的不完全覆盖、文件条件和重建错误。

blocks.en: Ambiguity in output definitions and protocols. Document structure admits multiple reasonable decompositions and serializations. Borderless tables, aligned fields, forms, and layouts with multiple columns can cross category boundaries, while visually equivalent tables may have different HTML or L a T e X representations. Benchmarks also use different region ontologies, annotation granularities, and matching rules, as illustrated by PubLayNet, DocLayNet, and OmniDocBench [ 92 , 179 , 96 , 155 ] . A reported score therefore reflects both the system’s reconstruction and the protocol’s definition of structure.
blocks.zh: 输出定义和协议模糊不清. 文档结构允许多种合理的分解和序列化. 无边框的表格,对齐的字段,窗体和布局与多个列可以跨越类别边界,而视觉等效的表格可能具有不同的HTML或L a T e X表示. 如PubLayNet、DocLayNet和OmniDoc Bench[92、179、96、155]所示,基准还使用不同的区域本体、注释颗粒和匹配规则。 因此,所报告的分数既反映了系统的重建和协议对结构的定义。

blocks.en: Composite score attribution. OmniDocBench v1.6 illustrates the attribution problem: its Overall score combines text, table, and formula metrics, while reading order is reported separately [ 155 ] . Similar overall scores can therefore represent different component profiles.
blocks.zh: 综合分数归属. OmniDoc Bench v1.6 说明了归属问题:其归属问题 总体分数结合了文本,表,和公式度量衡,而读取顺序则单独报告[155]. 因此,类似的总体分数可以代表不同的组成部分概况。

blocks.en: Coverage boundaries. Current benchmarks for complete pages concentrate on text, mathematical formulas, tables, layout regions, and reading order. Charts, flowcharts, chemical structures, and sheet music also encode content and structure that can be recovered from visual evidence; GOT, Logics-Parsing, and OCRVerse already output some of them from page images [ 8 , 223 , 10 ] . ParseBench extends evaluation to charts by checking sampled data points and their labels [ 202 ] , leaving the completeness of chart reconstruction outside this metric.
blocks.zh: 覆盖范围界限。 目前完成页的基准集中于文本,数学公式,表格,布局区域,以及读取顺序. 图表、流程图、化学结构和工作表音乐也编码内容和结构,可从视觉证据中恢复;Got、Logics-Parsing和OCRVerse已经从页面图像中输出了其中一些内容和结构[8、223、10]。 Parse Bench通过检查采样的数据点及其标签将评价扩展到图表[202],将图表重建的完整性留在这个度量表之外.

blocks.en: Coverage also varies by language, document length, and capture condition. MDPBench evaluates digital and photographed documents in 17 languages and reports larger errors on non-Latin scripts and photographed pages, particularly among open-source models [ 85 ] . Together with the controlled recaptures in Real5-OmniDocBench [ 97 ] , these results motivate reporting performance by language and capture condition. MPDocBench-Parse evaluates cross-page text and table merging and heading hierarchies in English and Chinese [ 86 ] . Extending these document-level tests to more languages would help establish whether multilingual reading also preserves structure across page breaks.
blocks.zh: 覆盖范围也因语言、文件长度和捕获条件而异。 MDP Bench用17种语言评价数字文件和照片,并报告非拉丁文字存在较大错误和照片页,特别是在开源模型中[85]. 这些结果与Real5-OmniDoc Bench的可控回收(Real5-OmniDoc Bench [97])一起,促使按语言和捕获条件报告业绩。 MPDoc Bench-Parse评价英文和中文的跨页文本和表格合并和标题等级[86]. 将这些文档级别的测试扩大到更多的语言将有助于确定多语种阅读是否也保留了整个分页的结构。

blocks.en: Faithfulness also requires targeted error checks. CHAOS-Bench measures whether models preserve words with deliberately altered characters when visual evidence conflicts with language priors [ 57 ] ; a missed match can reflect omission, correction, or another substitution. ParseBench separately includes checks for missing, unexpected, and repeated content [ 202 ] . Reporting these error types alongside aggregate text scores would show whether a system alters, omits, or invents content.
blocks.zh: 忠诚还需要有针对性地检查错误。 CHAOS-Bench测量模型在视觉证据与语言前缀冲突时是否保留带有故意改变的字符的单词[57];缺失的匹配可以反映省略,校正,或者另一种替代. Parse Bench单独包括了对缺失,出乎意料,以及重复内容的检查[202]. 在汇总文本分数的同时报告这些错误类型将显示一个系统是更改、省略还是发明内容。

blocks.en: V Discussion and Outlook
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论和展望

blocks.en: This survey defines OCR through faithful transcription, traces its development from specialist to unified models, and examines recognition and structural recovery using published benchmark results. Looking ahead, three expectations stand out.
blocks.zh: 这项调查通过忠实的转录来界定OCR,追溯其发展从专家模式到统一模式,并利用公布的基准结果审查识别和结构恢复。 展望未来,有三项期望显而易见。

blocks.en: First, as models and agents increasingly use OCR outputs, hallucinations, omissions, and structural errors can affect downstream results. Future work should strengthen verification of content accuracy, completeness, and structural relations against the source image. Second, requirements for accuracy, cost, and control differ across uses, so specialist, unified, and hybrid approaches will continue to coexist. Third, the object of reconstruction will keep widening, from text to the structure of whole documents, from single pages to many, from a few scripts to all writing systems, and from clean scans to whatever a camera captures, and evaluation must widen with it.
blocks.zh: 第一,随着模型和物剂越来越多地使用OCR输出,幻觉,遗漏,结构错误会影响下游结果. 今后的工作应加强内容准确性、完整性和结构关系对源图像的核查。 第二,对准确性、成本和控制的要求因用途不同而不同,因此专门、统一和混合的方法将继续共存。 第三,重建对象将不断拓宽,从文字到整个文件的结构,从单页到很多,从几个脚本到所有写作系统,从干净扫描到任何摄像头的捕捉,评价必须随之而扩大.

blocks.en: OCR’s lasting value lies in turning visually recorded information into accurate digital content that can be searched, edited, processed, and reused.
blocks.zh: OCR的持久价值在于将视觉记录的信息转化为精确的数字内容,可以搜索、编辑、处理和再利用。
